timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹2,413.7 Cr (+5.4% YoY), net profit ₹446.7 Cr (-4.6% YoY).
Bharti Hexacom’s Board recommended a **Rs. 18 per share final dividend** on May 13, 2026.
Bharti Hexacom Limited’s **Amit Chaturvedi** uploaded the Q4 FY2026 earnings call recording on May 14, 2026, per SEBI regulations.
Bharti Hexacom reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹2,414 Cr and recommended a dividend of ₹18 per share.
Bharti Airtel Limited, via **Rohit Krishan Puri**, declared no encumbrance on its shares in Bharti Hexacom Limited during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Bharti Hexacom reported Q1FY27 results with revenue growing 4% QoQ to ₹2,510 Cr and ARPU at ₹259.
